retrieval.rag_summary:
Higgins Insulation
Acoustic Sheet represents polyester or glass mineral wool acoustic sheet
insulation distributed for sound attenuation across commercial and residential
partition walls and ceilings. Higgins Insulation (operating out of Queensland,
Australia) manufactures and supplies thermal and acoustic batts and blankets for
building applications. When supplied in rigid or semi-rigid sheet form, these
products absorb airborne noise, reduce room reverberation, and provide
non-irritant, fiber-safe soundproofing for partition cavities and acoustic
linings.
